title: Singapore October inflation slows; mortgage resets remain contract-specific
summary: October's inflation release adds context for household budgets. Mortgage comparisons still require contract-specific benchmarks, reset dates and charges.

takeaways.text: October core inflation eased to 1.5% year on year; headline inflation slowed to 1.9%.
The existing October–December HDB mortgage rate remains 2.60% p.a. in CPF's quarterly calculation.

sections.heading: What the new release reports
sections.text: The 23 November release reports core inflation of 1.5%, down from September's 2.0%, and CPI-All Items inflation of 1.9%, down from 2.2%. Lower services and electricity & gas inflation reduced core inflation; private transport also contributed to the headline slowdown. Accommodation inflation stayed at 0.9%. Core excludes accommodation and private transport; CPI excludes house purchases.

sections.heading: Official outlook, not a mortgage forecast
sections.text: MAS and METI still describe upside inflation risks and expect core inflation to ease more clearly from mid-2027. This is their conditional outlook.

sections.heading: Existing loan context
sections.text: CPF's October–December calculation retains OA interest at 2.50% and HDB mortgage interest at 2.60%. Its bank-deposit input covers May–July, not current marginal funding costs. UOB's existing indicative completed-property schedule uses 3M compounded SORA plus 0.70% in years 1–2, 0.80% in year 3 and 1.00% thereafter, with a two-year lock-in and SGD250,000 minimum. It is a limited tranche for new direct-to-bank purchase/refinance customers; the Letter of Offer confirms terms.

sections.heading: What to confirm before comparing
sections.text: Our interpretation: slower consumer-price growth informs a household budget but does not establish a matching SORA or mortgage reduction. For floating loans, obtain the benchmark tenor, every spread stage and reset date; for fixed loans, check the fixed period and subsequent pricing. Compare eligibility, fees, penalties and subsidy clawbacks together. This review establishes no current SORA fixing, bank-funding trend or new confirmed promotion. UOB's maximum loan, complete charges and availability deadline remain unverified here.

sections.heading: Dates and scope
sections.text: October is the statistical reference month. The MAS release and PDF are dated 23 November; the release webpage also states a 23 November update. This report was written on 24 November in Asia/Singapore. CPF's page update is 22 September; UOB states no publication date. Actual successful reads are recorded separately in UTC. No offer-validity period is inferred, and earlier observations are not renewed.
